title: Software Engineer II, Support AI
description:
Ability to work East Coast hours required.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Are you bready* for a change?

The Support AI team is building voice and chat systems that handle customer support at scale—helping restaurants resolve issues quickly, often before they ever reach a human.

This is high-impact, real-world AI. When these systems work well, customers get unblocked instantly. When they don’t, it directly affects a restaurant’s ability to operate. Accuracy, speed, and reliability aren’t nice-to-haves—they’re critical.

We’re early in building these capabilities. Voice AI is launching, chat AI is improving, and we’re learning from real customer interactions as we build.

You’ll work in an environment where shipping fast, learning from real interactions, and building systems that scale all have to happen at once. You’ll put things into production to see what works, measure real customer outcomes, and iterate quickly—making pragmatic calls about when to move fast and when to invest for the long term.

As a Software Engineer II on Support AI, you’ll own features and components within these systems, from technical design through implementation, rollout, and ongoing improvements to our evolving voice and chat systems. You’ll work with product, support operations, and AI engineering teammates to clarify requirements, break work into manageable steps, and make technical decisions within your area. You’ll collaborate with senior engineers on broader architecture and decisions that affect the platform.

If you’re motivated by building AI systems that work in the real world and want to see your work directly improve how restaurants get help when they need it most, this is a role where you can have immediate, visible impact.

About this roll * (Responsibilities)

• Own delivery of features and components within our voice and chat AI systems, including technical design, implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration based on customer and operational outcomes.

• Build and maintain integrations with third-party AI platforms and internal Toast systems, accounting for API behavior, latency, reliability, and vendor constraints.

• Improve observability, monitoring, and outcome tracking for the components you own, using production data to identify issues and measure improvements.

• Break component-level work into sequenced tasks, communicate progress, and identify dependencies and blockers early.

• Partner with product, support operations, and AI/ML engineering teams to clarify requirements, identify edge cases, and translate support workflows into maintainable software.

• Make and explain technical tradeoffs within your area, and contribute to design discussions with teammates on changes that affect the broader system.

• Support teammates through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

Do you have the right ingredients* ? (Requirements)

• 2+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong background building and maintaining production systems using Java, Kotlin, or other object-oriented languages.

• Demonstrated ability to own a feature or component from design through production, including breaking down work, testing changes, and supporting them after release.

• Ability to clarify incomplete requirements, evaluate technical options, and explain tradeoffs with customer needs and operational constraints in mind.

• Strong collaborator who can work effectively across product, operations, and technical teams to deliver customer and business outcomes.

• Proficient with AI tooling such as Cursor, Claude, and MCP servers

• An ownership mindset: you investigate problems, identify blockers early, and seek input when needed to keep work moving.

title: Developer Evangelist
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Developer Evangelist.

About the job

This position is needed to help us inspire and equip a global network of millions of developers who will build the future of customer engagement. The Developer Evangelist specializing in AI technology will define developer relations and build the AI community in the Bay Area, while sustaining a relationship that fuels every developer's journey to know, use and love Twilio. The Developer Evangelist will serve as the regional liaison for local developer communities, build Twilio-powered solutions, such as SMS, Voice and Email, to address developer needs and partner with Marketing, Product and additional cross-functional teams. The role requires an understanding of the AI developer community and technical knowledge, as well as the ability to take complex ideas and make them accessible in order to inspire creativity through code.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Machine Learning Intern for Summer 2027! This is a paid, in-person, 12-week internship. On Maritime Digital Production, you will apply machine learning to the data that defines and tracks how our maritime vehicles are built: 3D CAD models with embedded manufacturing information, engineering drawings, and production and quality records. You will own a prototype from problem statement to demonstration, working with the engineers who author the models, the developers who build our manufacturing systems, and the technicians who build and inspect our vehicles.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Receive problem statements, guidelines, requirements, and reporting milestones

• Frame a manufacturing data problem as an ML task, build a labeled dataset from CAD models, drawings, or production records, and define how success will be measured

• Train and evaluate models (for example, graph or vision models on 3D geometry and drawings, or language and vision-language models for document understanding) and compare them against simple baselines

• Build the pipeline around the model: data extraction, preprocessing, evaluation, and a review step where engineers confirm or correct predictions

• Independently perform experiments and trade studies, and generate solutions for approval

• Test, verify, and demonstrate your prototype with the engineers who would use it, and document results and limits

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.

• Ability to complete an in-person 12-week internship in Santa Ana, CA, in summer 2027.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proficiency in Python and experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Coursework or project experience in machine learning, with a foundation in data structures, algorithms, calculus, probability, and statistics

• Experience in computer vision, graph neural networks, or natural language processing, including large language or vision-language models

• Experience designing experiments, analyzing results, and building end-to-end ML pipelines on real, messy datasets

• Familiarity with Git, Docker, Linux, and GPU or cloud training environments

• C++ or CUDA experience

• Experience using AI coding tools while critically validating their output

• Exposure to CAD, 3D geometry, engineering drawings, or manufacturing data

• Prior projects, research, or open-source work you can show, and strong technical communication skills
US Hourly Range

$42 — $60 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

•
No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications:

• Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

• Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

•
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

•
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, -record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Software Engineer, Backend, AI Ventures
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

We're looking for builders and former founders who want to take big swings at Ramp. You'll tackle important, open-ended problems, turn ideas into working products, and own what happens after launch. This is a backend engineering role for someone who wants to shape what we build, not just how we build it.

Ramp's AI bets span products like Glass, an AI assistant for getting work done; Inspect, a platform for coding agents; and AI Spend Management, which helps businesses understand and manage their AI and token spend. These are examples of the problems that excite us: changing how people work, how software gets built, and how businesses put AI to use.

You'll have the opportunity to build from 0–1 and scale from 1–100, bringing new AI products to life and turning early traction into lasting customer value. You'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers, stay close to users, and help find the next opportunities to accelerate Ramp's growth. You don't need to have started a company, but you should bring the same initiative, resourcefulness, and accountability.

What You’ll Do

• Own products and backend systems from problem discovery and technical design through the first launch, adoption, and ongoing iteration

• Turn ambiguous ideas into focused experiments, ship quickly, and use customer feedback and evidence to decide what to scale, change, or stop

• Build the APIs, data models, integrations, and workflows that bring new AI products to life

• Take promising products from 1–100 by improving reliability, performance, and the systems needed to support growing usage

• Partner with product, design, and go-to-market teams to connect technical decisions to customer value, adoption, and Ramp’s growth

• Make thoughtful bets, challenge assumptions, and balance speed with security, data correctness, and production quality

What You’ll Need

• A track record of building and shipping products people use, with meaningful ownership of the outcome

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience designing, building, and operating production services, APIs, and data models

• Product judgment: you can identify the real user problem, question a proposed solution, and make clear tradeoffs with incomplete information

• The initiative to create momentum without a complete specification, learn unfamiliar domains, and work beyond a narrow job description

• Clear communication and a collaborative approach to solving hard problems across engineering, product, design, and business teams

Nice to Haves

• Experience as a founder, founding engineer, or early engineer taking a product from idea to launch

• Experience building AI-powered products, agent systems or developer tools

• Experience scaling an early product into a reliable business and learning from customer adoption, retention, or revenue

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

• Flexible PTO

• Centralized home-office equipment ordering

• Health and wellness stipend

• Budget for intra-office travel

• Weekly coffee stipend

United States

• 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

• One Medical annual membership

• 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

• Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

• Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

• Pet insurance

• In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

• Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

• Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

• Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

• Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

• Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

• Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

• Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

• Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

• Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

• Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

• Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

descriptionHtml:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

We're looking for builders and former founders who want to take big swings at Ramp. You'll tackle important, open-ended problems, turn ideas into working products, and own what happens after launch. This is a backend engineering role for someone who wants to shape what we build, not just how we build it.

Ramp's AI bets span products like Glass, an AI assistant for getting work done; Inspect, a platform for coding agents; and AI Spend Management, which helps businesses understand and manage their AI and token spend. These are examples of the problems that excite us: changing how people work, how software gets built, and how businesses put AI to use.

You'll have the opportunity to build from 0–1 and scale from 1–100, bringing new AI products to life and turning early traction into lasting customer value. You'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers, stay close to users, and help find the next opportunities to accelerate Ramp's growth. You don't need to have started a company, but you should bring the same initiative, resourcefulness, and accountability.

  • Own products and backend systems from problem discovery and technical design through the first launch, adoption, and ongoing iteration

  • Turn ambiguous ideas into focused experiments, ship quickly, and use customer feedback and evidence to decide what to scale, change, or stop

  • Build the APIs, data models, integrations, and workflows that bring new AI products to life

  • Take promising products from 1–100 by improving reliability, performance, and the systems needed to support growing usage

  • Partner with product, design, and go-to-market teams to connect technical decisions to customer value, adoption, and Ramp’s growth

  • Make thoughtful bets, challenge assumptions, and balance speed with security, data correctness, and production quality

title: Software Engineer, Communication Safety
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As aSoftware Engineer on our Communication Safety team, you will join a high-impact team dedicated to detecting and mitigating unsafe communication across text and voice at a massive scale in real-time. You will work at the intersection of backend infrastructure and applied machine learning, ensuring that our safety systems are not only accurate but also highly performant and reliable.

This is a unique opportunity to solve complex technical challenges in real-time moderation of unsafe communication on the platform. You will need to help drive our system’s accuracy with continued low-latency execution, while supporting the massive scale of our global community.

You Will:

• Design, code, and test innovative capabilities within our core Communication Safety backend systems, navigating the full development lifecycle from initial design to production deployment.

• Over time, develop operational expertise while on-call to investigate issues ranging from GPU capacity, inference, speech recognition models, and model deployment reliability.

• Partner closely with the Communication product engineering teams to integrate our safety systems into the product experience, while working cross-functionally across Product Management, Policy, and Safety Ops teams to maintain high execution quality and pace.

• Improve the performance, reliability, and cost efficiency of our services.

• Be mentored by senior engineers and actively engaged in architectural discussions and system design for our text and voice safety solutions.

You Have:

• 1-3 years of experience in Software Engineering/Computer Science

• Strong proficiency in C# or Python, with a readiness to learn how to build and maintain scalable, high-availability backend services.

• Familiarity with the lifecycle of machine learning models, specifically around model serving, experimentation, and performance monitoring.

• Experience participating in production incidents, and a passion for improving observability and recovery times in distributed systems.

• Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product stakeholders to define requirements and deliver technical solutions.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page .

Annual Salary Range

$153,120 — $196,750 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Payments Engineering
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

• Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

• Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

• Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

• Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include:

• Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency.

• Leading our migration of enterprise pricing and usage processing, including new stream-processing services for usage events.

• Making it easy for customers to upgrade and pay, including paying through different entities and supporting new payment providers.

• Working with Finance and Tax teams to meet compliance, audit and reporting requirements.

• Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams.

• Debugging complex customer billing scenarios: piecing together what happened from the customer's experience, logs and code, and fixing the cause.

• Collaborating with Sales, FDEs, Finance and engineers across the company.

Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

• Expertise in Python.

• A strong background in backend development.

• Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

• Strong test design and security fundamentals.

• Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.

• The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues.

Bonus:

• Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems

• Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

• Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.

• Experience with Kubernetes.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

• Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

• Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Core Platform builds the foundations every other team at ElevenLabs builds on: how users, workspaces and permissions work across our products. Our systems sit on the path of every request and are relied on by millions of users and by enterprise customers, so correctness, security and safe rollout matter as much as speed.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) for two focus areas. Depending on the team you join, your responsibilities might include:

Workspaces & User Management (serving external customers)

• Building and improving the building blocks customers touch directly: API keys, login experience, analytics, admin tooling, workspace security and more

• Working closely with Sales, FDEs and customer teams to turn enterprise and self-serve feedback into the right improvements, and helping large customers with complex organisational structures.

• Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.

Permissions & Resources (serving ElevenLabs engineering teams)

• Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.

• Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.

• Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.

In both teams you will:

• Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.

• Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.

• Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.

• Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

• Expertise in Python.

• A strong background in backend development, with comfort working across the stack where the work needs it.

• Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

• Strong test design and security fundamentals.

• Care and attention to detail when changing live, business-critical systems, and the ability to learn a large existing codebase quickly.

• Comfort with ambiguity: working out what should be built, and prioritising among competing signals.

Bonus:

• Experience with authentication, authorization or permissioning (OAuth, SSO/SCIM, RBAC or similar).

• Experience with Kubernetes.

• Experience building internal platforms or services used by other engineering teams.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.

Permissions & Resources (serving ElevenLabs engineering teams)

  • Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.

  • Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.

  • Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.

In both teams you will:

  • Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.

  • Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.

  • Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.

  • Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

  • Expertise in Python.

  • A strong background in backend development, with comfort working across the stack where the work needs it.

  • Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

  • Strong test design and security fundamentals.

  • Care and attention to detail when changing live, business-critical systems, and the ability to learn a large existing codebase quickly.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: working out what should be built, and prioritising among competing signals.

Bonus:

  • Experience with authentication, authorization or permissioning (OAuth, SSO/SCIM, RBAC or similar).

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience building internal platforms or services used by other engineering teams.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own the intake, technical validation, coordination, and closure of externally reported vulnerabilities. You will validate and if needed, work directly with researchers and identify the engineering, product, infrastructure, or operations teams affected by each finding, then provide those teams with the evidence and context needed to resolve it.

You will also assist senior offensive security engineers throughout offensive security engagements; from scoping and target research through execution, reporting, remediation guidance, and retesting. As your technical breadth and judgment grow, you will independently own bounded portions of engagements in your demonstrated areas of strength.

This role is designed as a development path to Senior Offensive Security Engineer. It is not a vulnerability management ticket routing position or a reduced scope web testing role. You will be expected to validate attack paths, build practical prototypes and tooling, communicate with technical credibility, and steadily expand into unfamiliar target classes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Triage and coordinate bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure reports, including scope, quality, duplication,

• validity, impact, urgency, ownership, and case status.

• Reproduce reported behavior, adapt or complete proofs of concept where appropriate, establish affected components and conditions, and provide a clear technical basis for disposition and severity.

• Identify affected teams across Anduril, communicate the issue and practical attack path, establish accountable owners, and shepherd remediation across organizational boundaries.

• Retest fixes and mitigations implemented from internal offensive security engagements as well as external contributions.

• Monitor relevant CVE publications, vendor advisories, exploit research, and technical writeups; research applicability to Anduril systems and provide affected teams with concise exposure analysis and recommended

• next actions.

• Assist or shadow senior offensive security engineers on security research, engagement execution, and internal tooling prototypes.

• Independently execute bounded engagement work within demonstrated areas of experience and deliver technically sound findings, reproduction steps, and remediation guidance.

• Build and maintain scripts, proofs of concept, validation harnesses, agent assisted workflows, lab infrastructure, and documentation that make vulnerability response and offensive testing more repeatable.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years of hands on security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability research, or offensive security experience across two or more of the following:

• Web application penetration testing Cloud penetration testing

• Software or thick client penetration testing

• Firmware analysis

• Familiarity through practical projects, lab work, or assisted engagements across two or more of the following:

• Hardware penetration testing

• Red teaming

• Offensive use of agentic LLM systems

• Reverse engineering

• OT/ICS

• Experience reproducing and validating vulnerabilities, and using scripting, development, or LLMs to automate testing and validation workflows.

• Strong professional communication skills, with the ability to coordinate among researchers and engineering teams without losing technical accuracy or ownership.

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience triaging bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure submissions and driving reported issues through

• remediation and verified closure.

• Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, CWE, coordinated disclosure, and vulnerability case management workflows.

• Participation in scoped red team, hardware, firmware, reverse engineering, OT/ICS, or AI security

• engagements.

• or internally reviewable security research, technical walkthroughs, tools, lab projects, or proofs of

• concept.

• Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems, accept technical feedback, and expand from assisted work into independent engagement ownership.
US Salary Range

$114,000 — $196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

•
No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications:

• Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

• Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

•
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

•
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, -record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

• Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

• Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

• Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

• Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

• Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

• Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

• Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

• Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

• Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: [2027] Data Scientist - PhD Early Career - Safety
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?

The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and accuracy of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure impact on our community of players and developers.

WHY TRUST & SAFETY?

With our large and growing number of active users on Roblox, we are an ever more attractive target for malicious actors to both compromise user accounts and proliferate fake accounts for the purposes of spam and phishing. Using a combination of machine learning and engineering, you'll develop new techniques and signals to help automatically identify repeated bad actors across a set of accounts as quickly as possible and identify common patterns to proactively prevent future abuse.

You Are :

• Highly self-driven. You are perpetually curious and consistently strive to improve your skills by learning the latest modeling techniques and data tools. You thrive with freedom and autonomy and are excited by exploring new problem spaces.

• A strong communicator. You understand that analysis must be presented in meaningful ways and engage in spirited discussions about the findings. You have the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and discuss appropriate tradeoffs.

• Motivated by impact. You find great satisfaction in being able to point to direct contributions you've made to an organization. You recognize the inherent tradeoffs between further research/experimentation and productionization apply the appropriate methodology to maximize impact.

• Experienced in developing models and interest in taking work from research to production. You are capable of using machine learning and statistical techniques to model a variety of different types of data from time-series and sequential data to unstructured data like text and images.

You Will :

• Reporting to the Senior Director, you will accelerate product development through your understanding of the underlying data and your ability to partner with product and technical leaders to provide insights that lead to the safest experiences for Roblox's sizable user base.

• Investigate new ways to discover automated behavior on the Roblox platform.

• Develop modeling solutions to identify new attacks and signals of malicious user behavior.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to push detection systems toward real-time identification.

Basic Qualifications :

• Possess or pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Applied Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Economics or other technical field

• Experience in statistical modeling and machine learning

• Experience with deep learning/modern ML techniques

Preferred Qualifications :

• Problem Solving: Ability to frame ambiguous problems, designing analytical approaches, and solving open-ended data science problems that could drive business impact.

• Training or fine-tuning machine learning models
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page .

Annual Salary Range

descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?

The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and accuracy of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure impact on our community of players and developers.

WHY TRUST & SAFETY?

With our large and growing number of active users on Roblox, we are an ever more attractive target for malicious actors to both compromise user accounts and proliferate fake accounts for the purposes of spam and phishing. Using a combination of machine learning and engineering, you'll develop new techniques and signals to help automatically identify repeated bad actors across a set of accounts as quickly as possible and identify common patterns to proactively prevent future abuse.

You Are:

  • Highly self-driven. You are perpetually curious and consistently strive to improve your skills by learning the latest modeling techniques and data tools. You thrive with freedom and autonomy and are excited by exploring new problem spaces.
  • A strong communicator. You understand that analysis must be presented in meaningful ways and engage in spirited discussions about the findings. You have the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and discuss appropriate tradeoffs.
  • Motivated by impact. You find great satisfaction in being able to point to direct contributions you've made to an organization. You recognize the inherent tradeoffs between further research/experimentation and productionization apply the appropriate methodology to maximize impact.
  • Experienced in developing models and interest in taking work from research to production. You are capable of using machine learning and statistical techniques to model a variety of different types of data from time-series and sequential data to unstructured data like text and images.

You Will:

  • Reporting to the Senior Director, you will accelerate product development through your understanding of the underlying data and your ability to partner with product and technical leaders to provide insights that lead to the safest experiences for Roblox's sizable user base.
  • Investigate new ways to discover automated behavior on the Roblox platform.
  • Develop modeling solutions to identify new attacks and signals of malicious user behavior.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to push detection systems toward real-time identification.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Possess or pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Applied Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Economics or other technical field
  • Experience in statistical modeling and machine learning
  • Experience with deep learning/modern ML techniques

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Problem Solving: Ability to frame ambiguous problems, designing analytical approaches, and solving open-ended data science problems that could drive business impact.
  • Training or fine-tuning machine learning models

title: Software Engineer, Backend - Government Products
location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Our engineering group is composed of the Brokerage, Incentives, and Identity teams, which are essential to our core platform and user growth. Together, we build and scale services that support trading, deliver personalized rewards, and protect our customers by preventing fraud. We collaborate with teams across Data Science, Crypto, Security, and Product to build reliable infrastructure! Our culture is high-performing, fast-moving, and ethical in everything we do.

As a Software Engineer, Backend - Government Products, you will design, build, and own backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s core products. You will solve complex scalability challenges while gaining deep expertise in financial systems and making a direct impact on the products used by millions. In this position, you will build product-facing features and platform enhancements that meet strict correctness standards. You will partner with engineering leads and product managers to deliver impactful technical solutions that expand our services.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Design, build, test, and deploy scalable backend services and systems with a strong emphasis on long-term maintainability.

• Develop product-facing features and platform enhancements that meet strict correctness and scalability standards.

• Identify and implement improvements to system performance, engineering productivity, and risk reduction.

• Collaborate closely with client teams, product partners, and external vendors to deliver impactful technical solutions.

What you bring

• 2+ years of experience in software development.

• Strong track record of successfully delivering large-scope technical projects in collaborative team environments partnering across engineering, product, and operations.

• Commitment to high standards in code quality and review processes.

• Solid understanding of backend development, system design, and the intersection of product and engineering.

• Proficiency in Go or Python.

• Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar data streaming technologies.

• Familiarity with managing and processing large-scale datasets.

Bonus points

• Experience working at a fintech company or financial institution.

• Familiarity with technologies like Postgres, Kubernetes (K8s), Redis, and AWS (or similar cloud platforms).

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.

• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.

• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

• Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.

• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.

• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Position Restriction: This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)

$166,000 — $195,000 USD

Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)

$147,000 — $172,000 USD

Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)

$130,000 — $152,000 USD

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

title: Software Engineer, Enterprise
description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Engineer to join as an early member of our new Enterprise team. The consumer story has demonstrated Replit’s magic and now we are seeing use cases emerge in the B2B space that are ripe for innovation and growth. It is a critical area for our success this year and beyond.

You can be part of the journey to build and scale features that help teams and organizations of any size be more productive with Replit. This is an opportunity to make meaningful impact and shape the culture and processes from the ground up. Working closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and AI engineers, you'll craft solutions that enable our customers to build, deploy, and share their applications seamlessly. This role requires both technical expertise and a deep understanding of user needs to deliver features that make an impact.

In this role you will:

• Build and own features across the full stack that serve enterprise customers, from backend services to user-facing interfaces

• Design and implement scalable solutions for teams and organizations. This includes enterprise-readiness features like authentication, permissions, security, and compliance, as well as tools that improve team collaboration and drive adoption within an organization.

• Work directly with customers to understand their needs and iterate on solutions

• Contribute to technical decisions and architecture for the Enterprise platform

• Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

• Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering excellence

• Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data

Required skills and experience:

• Strong full stack engineering skills with experience shipping production code

• Experience building B2B or enterprise software products

• Comfort working across the stack - from databases and APIs to frontend frameworks

• Strong product sense and ability to translate customer needs into technical solutions

• Experience with modern web technologies (React, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar)

• Track record of shipping high-impact features and taking ownership of projects

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams

• Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and domains

Nice to Have:

• Experience with enterprise authentication and authorization systems (SSO, SAML, SCIM)

• Experience with AI/LLM integration in applications

• Understanding of developer tools, internal tools, and workflows

• Previous experience in a high-growth startup environment

• Contributions to open-source projects

Tools + Tech Stack for this role:

• React, TypeScript, CSS, GraphQL, Node.js, and Postgres

This role may not be a fit if:

• You prefer working exclusively on backend systems without user interaction

• You're uncomfortable with the pace and changing priorities of a startup environment

• You require highly structured requirements and aren't comfortable with ambiguity

This is a full-time role that is held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match ( US Only )

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits ( In-Office & US Only )

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement ( In-Office Only )

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities ( In-Office Only )

Want to learn more about what we are up to?

• Self-driving Company

• Replit Agent at Scale

• AI Adoption

• Build Open-Source Apps

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

• Operating Principles

• Reasons not to work at Replit

To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.

title: Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F , led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Join Cloud Platform Engineering to own the Kubernetes fleet that runs our production AI workloads. You’ll turn manual cluster operations into reliable, repeatable systems—from bringing new cloud providers online to rolling out configuration and upgrades safely across the entire fleet.

This is a hands-on software engineering role with ownership from design through production. You’ll build APIs, controllers, and automation that make infrastructure easier to operate, reduce configuration drift, and bring GPU capacity online seamlessly to power the AI inference business growth.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

• Unify Kubernetes platform configuration under GitOps, replacing duplicated cluster manifests with shared configuration and explicit provider overrides.

• Automate cluster onboarding and provisioning with reusable infrastructure templates, readiness checks, and recoverable workflows.

• Build controllers and rollout mechanisms for fleet upgrades and workload-aware maintenance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Software Engineer I, Payments
description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X , and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog . Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

For many of our creators, streaming on Twitch is a career, and our payment systems are central to making this possible. We're operating at a massive scale and you'll help millions of creators to earn a living doing what they love.

As a key member of the engineering team, you will report to the Senior Engineering Manager of Payments team and have the opportunity to build and scale solutions that affect millions of users and broadcasters. You will take high ownership of your services - architecting, building and operating them. You will partner with other engineers, product managers, designers and data specialists to deliver solutions.

Our team is based in San Francisco, CA

You Will:

• Work with technical leads and other engineers to design and develop commerce/payments platform and services

• Contribute to customer-focused project deliveries

• Work with other teams to clarify product requirements

• Improve engineering processes

• Participate in design and code reviews

You Have:

• Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or prior relevant engineering experiences

• Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, data modeling and schema design

• 1+ years as an software engineer

• Experience creating detailed technical documentation

• Proficient experience level in one or more of the following language: Go, Ruby, Java, C++

• Familiar with AWS ecosystem

Bonus Points

• Experience in commerce or payments domain

• Twitch user, broadcaster, or partner or experience in the gaming industry

• Familiarity with AWS infrastructure

• Experience writing Go in production systems

Perks

• Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance

• 401(k)

• Maternity & Parental Leave

• Flexible PTO

• Amazon Employee Discount

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Job ID: TW9327

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits .

US, CA, San Francisco

$127,100 — $185,000 USD

Twitch is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Twitch values your privacy. Please consult our Candidate Privacy Notice , for information about how we collect, use, and disclose personal information of our candidates.
