title: Software Engineer, Fullstack, Spend Controls
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Great spend controls help businesses move quickly without losing control of their money. Ramp’s Spend Controls team builds the core capabilities behind Ramp’s most critical primitives, like budgets and cards,helping customers put spending policies into practice and understand how their money is being deployed.

We’re looking for a fullstack engineer to build and improve these experiences, from the interfaces admins use to configure controls to the backend logic that makes them work reliably. You’ll build and own new features end to end, simplify complex spending workflows, and improve the quality of products customers depend on every day.

What You’ll Do

• Build fullstack features to improve how customers manage the lifecycle of issued money, with clearer behavior and sensible defaults

• Work with product, design, and engineering partners to turn customer needs into well-scoped features and deliver them from technical design through launch and iteration

• Build better visibility into spend and utilization, including configurable restrictions and sensible buffers, so that users can spend money easily, while transactions that shouldn’t happen are declined properly

• Contribute to on-call support, investigate production issues, and address recurring problems through testing and targeted quality improvements

What You’ll Need

• Experience building and shipping production features across frontend interfaces and backend services

• The ability to own a feature end to end, break down the work, design key components, and follow through on delivery

• Sound judgment about data correctness, reliability, and keeping complex product behavior understandable

• A customer-focused approach to building software, with attention to usability and practical tradeoffs

• Experience testing and debugging software, including investigating issues in production

• Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working with product, design, and engineering teammates

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

• Flexible PTO

• Centralized home-office equipment ordering

• Health and wellness stipend

• Budget for intra-office travel

• Weekly coffee stipend

United States

• 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

• One Medical annual membership

• 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

• Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

• Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

• Pet insurance

• In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

• Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

• Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

• Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

• Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

• Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

• Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

• Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

• Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

• Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

• Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

• Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @ Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice

title: Contract Student Worker- Software Engineer Mobile Developer Experience
description:
About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Contract Worker Program

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

Zoox is looking for a Software Engineering contract student worker to join our Mobile Apps Engineering team. In this role, you will help build and improve the CI/CD pipelines and tooling that our engineers use to build, test, and ship Zoox's iOS and Android rider apps. You will work closely with senior engineers to make our development and release process faster, more reliable, and more secure, so that every update reaches our riders with confidence.

Responsibilities

•
Help build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that compile, test, and package our iOS and Android applications.

•
Automate repetitive build and release tasks, such as versioning, code signing, and distribution to internal testers via TestFlight and Google Play.

•
Improve build speed and reliability by investigating pipeline failures, flaky tests, and bottlenecks.

Required Qualifications

•
Add automated quality checks (unit tests, linting, static analysis) that catch issues before they reach riders.

•
[placeholder]

•
Create dashboards and alerts that give the team visibility into build health and release status.

•
Write clear documentation so engineers can easily understand and use our tooling.

Bonus Qualifications

•
Collaborate with mobile, cloud, and release engineering teams across Zoox to learn how software moves from a pull request to a rider's phone.

•
Currently pursuing or has obtained a BS / MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

•
Familiarity with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Ruby, TypeScript, Bash, Kotlin, or Swift).

•
Basic understanding of Git and version control workflows.

Program Requirements

•
Comfort working from the command line on macOS or Linux.

•
Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.

•
Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and an eagerness to learn from feedback.

•
Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.

•
Able to commit a minimum of 40 hours per week.

•
Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.

•
Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

Closing

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Part-Time Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

About Zoox

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

title: Contract Student Worker - Software Engineer (40hrs/wk)
description:
About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Contract Student Worker Program

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

This engineer will work with the HIL team to build and scale subsystem level latency testing across the software org.

Responsibilities

•
Develop test platforms for sub-system integration testing, with a focus on developing a scaleable, open loop, HIL environment.

•
Contribute to development of our on-robot software infrastructure

•
Contribute to the design and development of our integration testing framework

Required Qualifications

•
Bachelors in Computer Science or equivalent field

•
Experience programming in Python or C++ in large code bases

•
Experience designing software and tooling

Bonus Qualifications

•
A firm understanding of the software life cycle and common software design principles

•
Experience with robot middleware (ex: ROS)

Program Requirements

•
Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.

•
Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.

•
Able to commit a minimum of 40 hours per week.

•
Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.

•
Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

Closing

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Contract Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

About Zoox

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

SailPoint’s Cybersecurity organization is seeking a Security Software Engineer with a passion for cybersecurity and protecting the organization.

As an integral member of SailPoint’s Security Architecture and Engineering team, you will take on a challenging and highly impactful role that goes far beyond out-of-the-box vendor capabilities. We are looking for an API-first problem-solver to write the custom code and tool-agnostic middleware necessary to bridge our diverse security stacks. By building these advanced integrations, you will unlock maximum value and next-level security controls from our existing investments, giving you the unique opportunity to directly shape the future of our technical defenses and drive the execution of our overarching security program.

You will join a highly capable team of emerging and established talent, collaborating across Security Operations, IT, and Engineering to serve as a technical ambassador for the Cyber organization. We need a builder who naturally embodies SailPoint’s 4 I’s (Individual, Impact, Innovation, and Integrity) - someone who eagerly embraces complex challenges and acts as a positive, driving force within our thriving work culture. Ultimately, your innovative solutions will not only secure our enterprise but contribute meaningfully to the broader cyber ecosystem.

This position can be remote or based in Austin, TX.

Support and help maintain automated deployment pipelines for security controls, incident response playbooks (SOAR), and continuous monitoring workflows

description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Our team sits within Developer Productivity, whose mission is to make software development at Affirm simpler and faster across the company. The broader org owns much of the path between a developer’s laptop and production, including developer environments, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, dependency management, and release engineering, all in service of helping engineers ship code quickly, safely, and with confidence.

The Continuous Delivery team’s charter is centered on enabling engineering teams to release independently through strong automation, standard patterns, predictable rollouts, resilient recovery mechanisms, and less manual toil. This role is uniquely positioned to help solve one of Affirm’s most important engineering challenges: scaling developer productivity in an era where the software development lifecycle is increasingly AI-enhanced. The team builds and improves the platforms, workflows, and guardrails that help engineers move from idea to production faster, with better safety, consistency, and developer experience.

We value engineers who listen closely, invite feedback, and work well across organizational boundaries, while also holding a high bar for ownership, technical judgment, and follow-through. Strong candidates will care about building reliable shared systems, reducing friction for other engineers, and making durable improvements that raise the quality and speed of software delivery across Affirm.
title: Software Engineer I, Backend (Continuous Delivery)

· You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
· You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
· Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

title: Software Engineer II - Flows Experience
description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Software Engineer II - Flows

Onsite in Boston, MA 5 days a week

Flows is how tens of thousands of brands automate their marketing on Klaviyo, from welcome series and abandoned-cart reminders to complex multi-channel journeys that reach 100M+ consumers. The Flows Experience team builds everything a marketer touches in a flow: the canvas, triggers, filters and actions they configure, the analytics they use to decide what to do next, and the APIs that developers and AI tools use to build flows for them.
Our mission: Flows should be the easiest, most trusted place to run sophisticated marketing automation. Complex journeys should feel simple, mistakes should get caught before they cost revenue, and the product should keep up as an account grows.

We want a Full Stack Engineer who likes owning features end to end, from the React canvas down to the Python services and APIs underneath. You’ll work closely with Flows Platform, the team that runs the engine behind every flow, and with product and design, to ship work customers notice right away. Recently the team made large flows open up to 70% faster, launched an API (also in the Klaviyo MCP) that lets developers and AI agents safely edit live flows, and raised webhook throughput 20x.

How you’ll make a difference

• Own major parts of the Flows product (the builder, analytics, version history, management surfaces) from design through launch and operation

• Design and evolve the and internal Flows APIs that define how a flow can change. Customers, partners and AI agents all build on them.

• Make the product fast and reliable for very large flows and very large accounts, whether that means canvas render performance, a slow analytics query or an API under heavy load

• Build guardrails that catch mistakes before they cost a brand revenue: validation, safe defaults, clear feedback and easy recovery

• Partner with Flows Platform on the contract between the product and the engine, so new capabilities scale from day one

• Raise the bar for your team as a technical leader through design reviews, mentorship, operational excellence and modern, AI-assisted ways of building

Who you are

• You’ve built and shipped products that customers rely on, and you care about the user experience as much as the code

• You’re strong across the stack. You know at least one area deeply (complex front-end apps, API design, or backend performance) and are comfortable working in the others.

• You enjoy hard problems at the line between UX and systems: a canvas that lags with 200 nodes, a workflow with too many clicks, a query that times out, a queue that won’t drain

• You ship early and often, use data and customer feedback to iterate, and work closely with product and design

• You thrive on a small, autonomous team where you own outcomes and collaborate widely to get them right

• You’re curious about how AI changes both what we build (agents that build flows) and how we build it

Technologies we use (not exhaustive)

• React, TypeScript, JavaScript

• Python, Django, Celery

• MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka

• AWS, Terraform, and modern observability and CI/CD tooling

title: Data Scientist Intern [Summer 2027]
description:
About Our Internship Program

Zoox’s internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry's brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek interns who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox' s mission to create autonomous mobility from the ground up.

Job Description

As an intern in the Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA) team within System Design & Mission Assurance, you will apply rigorous statistical methods and machine learning techniques to quantify safety and risk across our autonomous driving systems. You will work with complex, real-world fleet and simulation datasets to model rare safety events, establish statistical baselines, and develop metrics that validate the safety and mission assurance of our purpose-built robotaxi.

In this Role, You Will…

• Formulate and build statistical and machine learning models to evaluate system performance and analyze rare, high-consequence safety events.

• Process and analyze large-scale datasets using SQL, Python, or distributed data frameworks (Spark/Databricks) to extract actionable insights on vehicle behavior and operational risk.

• Apply advanced statistical methods (e.g., Poisson processes, GLMs, Bayesian inference, point process models, or spatial-temporal modeling) to evaluate safety-critical metrics.

• Collaborate with systems engineers and safety leads to translate complex quantitative models into rigorous mission assurance decisions.

Internship Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. in Statistics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related quantitative engineering/scientific discipline.

• Enrolled in good academic standing at an accredited college or university throughout the internship.

• Expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028 .

• Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship beginning in May/June 2027 .

• Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship.

• Interns at Zoox may not use any proprietary information they are working on as part of their thesis, any published work with their university, or to be distributed to anyone outside of Zoox.

Qualifications

• Statistical Foundations: Deep understanding of probability theory, regression, Generalized Linear Models (GLMs), hypothesis testing, and Bayesian methods. Experience or coursework in spatial statistics, space-time models, point process models, or causal inference.

• Machine Learning & Modeling: Strong fundamentals in statistical modeling and ML (supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, and metric evaluation).

• Data Manipulation & Querying: Proficiency with basic-to-intermediate SQL and Python for data querying, data cleaning, and statistical modeling (or alternative data packages such as Spark, dplyr , or R).

• Communication & Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous operational or system questions into structured statistical problems and clearly communicate complex quantitative findings to technical stakeholders.

Bonus Qualifications

• Large-Scale Data Processing: Experience querying, pipeline-building, and modeling massive datasets using Spark, Databricks, or cloud platforms.

• Rare-Event Modeling & Domain Experience: Familiarity with autonomous vehicles, transportation network companies (TNCs), quantitative safety/risk modeling, or fraud/rare-event detection.

• AI-Assisted Workflow & Tooling: Experience utilizing AI-assisted data analysis, modern coding agents, or LLM-driven research workflows to accelerate data exploration and model development.
Compensation

The monthly salary range for this position is $6,500 to $10,500 . Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level of education (Master's vs. Ph.D.). Additional benefits may include medical insurance and a housing stipend (relocation assistance will be offered based on eligibility).

About Zoox

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Role Description

As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions.

Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here .

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams.

• Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns.

• Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments.

• Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows.

• Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

• 4 + years of experience in application security or security engineering roles.

• Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security.

• Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports.

• Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native environments.

• Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies.

• Comfortable working in cross-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously.

• Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on-call rotations is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation.

• Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows.

• Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI-driven products.

• Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.

• Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production-level code in one or more modern languages.

• Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms.

• Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption.

• Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross-functional teams.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

• Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others .

• Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations .

descriptionHtml:
Role Description

As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions.

Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments.
  • Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows.
  • Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports.
  • Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native environments.
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies.
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on-call rotations is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows.
  • Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI-driven products.
  • Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production-level code in one or more modern languages.
  • Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms.
  • Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross-functional teams.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

description:
MongoDB’s Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations modernize legacy applications and move their workloads and associated data from relational databases to MongoDB. Our customers need a dependable way to bring analysis, transformation, testing, and migration capabilities into their modernization workflows.

The Agentic Integrations team builds the interfaces that let AMP capabilities be discovered, invoked, and orchestrated from AI agents and development environments. We expose product services through consistent, well-specified tool and API surfaces, keep authentication and execution context correct across every boundary, and make each integration observable and safe to operate. Our work is what makes AMP usable from the assistants and coding agents our customers already run.

We are looking for a Software Engineer 3 to build and operate these integrations. You will design tool and API surfaces for AMP services, implement them end to end, and work with product and platform engineers so that they behave predictably when a model calls them. Your impact will be measured by how reliably agents and developers can invoke AMP capabilities, and by how much integration work your components remove for other teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City for our hybrid working model.

What you will do

• Design and implement agent and developer facing integrations for AMP services, including tool definitions, API clients, and the adapters between them

• Define clear input and output contracts for each integration, including validation, error semantics, and behavior when a call is malformed or only partially succeeds

• Propagate authentication, authorization, and tenant context across integration boundaries so that agent-invoked calls carry no more privilege than the user they act for

• Build the instrumentation needed to observe agent-driven traffic, including structured logs, traces, latency and failure metrics, and actionable diagnostics

• Write production-quality code and the unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that demonstrate correctness, including tests for nondeterministic model behavior

• Diagnose failures that span service, tool, and model boundaries, and drive them to root cause

• Contribute integrations to shared SDKs, command-line tools, and agent frameworks used by other teams

• Collaborate with product managers, platform engineers, and partner teams on scoped initiatives, and break work into incremental deliverables

• Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions that raise the quality of the team’s work

• Interview candidates and mentor engineers and interns

What you bring

Required

• At least four years of experience building and operating production software services

• Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript, with the judgment to work effectively in more than one

• Experience designing APIs or service interfaces, including versioning, error handling, and backward compatibility

• Practical experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, API keys, or service-to-service identity

• Experience with automated testing, continuous delivery, and debugging in distributed systems

• Strong written and verbal technical communication skills

• A collaborative approach and the ability to make realistic assessments of project complexity and delivery risk

Preferred

• Experience building tool or integration surfaces for AI agents or large language models, including execution context, tool schemas, or guardrails against nondeterministic behavior

• Experience with the Model Context Protocol or a comparable agent-to-tool integration standard

• Experience shipping developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs, or local servers that run inside customer-managed environments

• Familiarity with application modernization, relational databases, MongoDB, or automated code transformation

• Experience working with customers or field teams on integration and deployment issues

• Experience mentoring engineers or interns and contributing to technical hiring

Candidates with additional relevant experience may be considered for more senior roles.

What success looks like

In your first month

• Build a working understanding of AMP’s architecture, the team’s integration patterns, and the development and testing workflow.

• Ship small, well-scoped integration fixes and contribute effectively to code reviews.

In your first three months

• Own delivery of an integration for one AMP capability, from interface definition through production rollout.

• Establish the tests and telemetry that let the team detect and diagnose failures in that integration.

In your first six months

• Take regular ownership of code reviews and participate meaningfully in design reviews for agent-facing interfaces.

• Independently drive a scoped technical project from investigation through implementation and validation, coordinating with the partner team that consumes it.

In your first twelve months

• Lead the development of a substantial integration or reusable component that other teams adopt.

• Help mentor new engineers and contribute to the team’s integration standards and technical direction.

Why MongoDB

At MongoDB, you will work with engineers who care deeply about developer experience, data correctness, and the interfaces that other software builds on. The Agentic Integrations team sits where the data platform meets the agentic tooling our customers are adopting, so your work will be visible in the products and assistants they use every day. You will have the scope to shape how AMP capabilities are exposed, and the support to grow into deeper ownership of the integration layer.

MongoDB is committed to creating a supportive and inclusive environment where employees can grow and do their best work. Our benefits and employee programs are designed to support people through every stage of their professional and personal lives.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Req ID: 4273608317

MongoDB’s base salary range for this role is posted below. Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate and based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location. Salary is one part of MongoDB’s total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. Please note, the base salary range listed below and the benefits in this paragraph are only applicable to U.S.-based candidates.

MongoDB’s base salary range for this role in the U.S. is:

$106,000 — $209,000 USD

title: Software Engineer - Virtual Platform
description:
About Team

Asgard Cloud cluster at Rubrik is the virtual platform engineering team. Our mission is to make the Rubrik platform available in clouds and other virtualized environments. We design the virtual platform and are responsible for meeting software defined datacenter requirements for large enterprises. Also, we are responsible for Rubrik’s Cloud Cluster solution which is among our most popular products. All of these serve as the backbone for powering Rubrik’s industry leading Data Protection and Data Management solutions. We have very talented engineers in the team at all levels and we are looking for a new college graduate to join the team of great talent.

About the Role

As an engineer in the team you will be designing, developing, testing, deploying and operationalizing highly scalable, reliable and cost optimized solutions in cloud environments. As part of that, you will

• Take full ownership of projects end to end.

• Collaborate with functional partners like product manager, designer for requirements

• Diagnose and resolve customer problems,performance bottlenecks in complex customer environments

• Build observability tools to proactively monitor and learn product usage and customer issues

As a platform team, this opportunity provides technical challenges, influencing and collaborating with multiple teams and a fast paced start up like environment.

What are we looking for?

• Bachelor / Master in Computer Science or equivalent with 0-1 years of experience.

• Excellent in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems design

• Exceptional problem-solving abilities

• Solid background or education in Systems programming

• Programming and debugging knowledge in C++, Java, Scala

• Strong interest in learning new technologies, solve complex problems and challenges

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge in Storage, Filesystems or Data Protection technologies is a plus

• Knowledge in cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US Pay Range

$131,400 — $197,200 USD

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com

Inclusion @ Rubrik

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:

•
Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.

•
Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

•
Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.

Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact hr@rubrik.com . Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.

title: Contract Student Worker – Firmware Engineer (FW Core System Services)
description:
About Zoox

Zoox is transforming mobility with fully autonomous, electric vehicles designed from the ground up for a driverless future. Our mission is to make transportation safer, more sustainable, and accessible to everyone. At Zoox, innovation, collaboration, and a bold vision for the future drive everything we do.

About Our Part Time Student Worker Program

Zoox’s program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry’s brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek part time student workers who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox’s mission.

Project Overview

Zoox is seeking a motivated Firmware Engineer student worker to join our team, focusing on diagnostic infrastructure for the Core Firmware System Services team. This is an opportunity to own highly-visible, foundational projects where you will extend our existing diagnostic infrastructure. You will work on the full development cycle of robot firmware development.

In this role, you will:

• Work on the development of UDS, DoIP, and XCP clients and servers for current and next generation platforms

• Develop and test embedded software for reporting diagnostic and configuration

• Contribute to all phases of the software development cycle including prototyping, requirements capture, design, implementation, and validation

• Collaborate with system, software, hardware, and test engineers to define, implement, and validate diagnostic requirements

Qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in modern C++ for software development

• Experience with Python programming

• Experience with application development targeting a unix-like environment
Bonus Qualifications:

• Familiarity with C++ unit testing principles and framework such as gtest

• Experience with real-time operating systems

• Network introspection and debugging at and above the transport layer

• Industrial or automotive fieldbuses and diagnostics standards (e.g., CAN, J1939, EtherCAT, UDS, SOVD)

• One or more inter-process communication mechanisms

• Event- or message-driven software systems
Program Requirements:

• Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S., in a relevant engineering field

• Available for a 6 month project

• Able to commit to at least 20 hours per week

• Ability to commute on-site to one of our offices

• Student Worker may not use proprietary Zoox information in university theses, publications, or share it outside

$30 per hour.

This is a contract position and employment for this position will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly pay range is posted and you will be eligible for a benefits package as offered by the vendor.

title: Contract Student Worker - Software Engineer (20/hrs week)
description:
About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Contract Student Worker Program

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

Zoox is bringing its robotaxi service to cities across the US. Every new city needs depots to house and maintain the fleet, and pickup/dropoff locations at the places riders want to go most: hotels, airports, stadiums and event venues. In this role, you will own and grow the internal web tools that coordinate this rollout, giving teams a single, clear view of every site from planning to launch.

Responsibilities

• Own the expansion-tracking web tools end to end, from feature request to release

title: Software Engineer I, Commerce
description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X , and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog . Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

Join Twitch’s Memberships team within the Commerce Engineering organization, where we’re building rewarding experiences allowing creators to make a living doing what they love. We’re the team behind our continuous patronage features including channel Subscriptions, Gifting, and Turbo.

As a member of our team, you’ll work alongside our highly engaged and collaborative team to design, build and maintain systems that scale to millions of concurrent users. We actively seek to improve our experiences and are looking for members that are passionate about our end users.

You Will:

• Work with product managers, designers, technical leads, and other engineers to design, develop, launch, and operate interactive experiences and products

• Work backwards from customer problems to drive business impact

• Create interactive experiences that are rewarding for both viewers and creators

• Architect and build robust, scalable applications that can handle millions of concurrent users
Participate in Operational Excellence work to maintain and support our live services

You Have:

• Experience developing software in a professional environment

• Prior experience building consumer-facing products at scale

• Proficient coding skills in modern languages and frameworks such as Go, React, Kotlin, Swift, Objective-C etc

• Proven ability with thinking though and delivering quality user experiences.

• Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Bonus Points

• Experience with languages/frameworks we use at Twitch: React, Typescript, Golang

• Experience building software and services using AWS technologies such as ECS, DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS, and Step Functions

• Experience working with mobile development, either native or hybrid

• Familiarity with Twitch, gaming, and/or streaming on Twitch

Perks

• Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance

• 401(k)

• Maternity & Parental Leave

• Flexible PTO

• Amazon Employee Discount

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Job ID: TW9323

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits .

US, WA, Seattle - Annually

$110,500 — $160,000 USD

US, CA, San Francisco - Annually

$127,100 — $185,000 USD

Twitch is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Twitch values your privacy. Please consult our Candidate Privacy Notice , for information about how we collect, use, and disclose personal information of our candidates.

title: Software Engineer, Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

Join our AI-centric internship cohort and build the future of financial software! As an Engineering Intern, you'll collaborate with a mentor and team to develop impactful products, services, and infrastructure that accelerate the adoption of AI-first tools and workflows across Brex. You'll leverage data and creativity to solve real-world business challenges and contribute to our long-term technical vision. This is your chance to push the boundaries of financial technology and directly shape Brex's growth.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office - Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Requirements

• Availability to participate in the program from June to September, 2027

• Strong knowledge of CS fundamentals

• Strong communication, interpersonal skills, and eagerness to learn from others

• Are excited about working in a high-paced environment with other high quality engineers

• Familiarity with software engineering development cycles

• Experience working with backend programming languages (i.e. Java, Kotlin, Python)

• Experience working with SQL or NoSQL databases

• Ability to hold yourself and the team to high standards

Bonus points

• Experience with AI tooling

• Experience collaborating with experts in product, design, and operations

• Familiarity with functional programming languages

• Proactive mindset, leading with curiosity first

• Experience with corporate financial systems or concepts

• Experience with cloud computing systems & services

Compensation:

The expected salary range for this role is $55.00 per hour. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

title: Software Engineer, ROS Open Platform & AI Enablement
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Software Engineer on the ROS team, you'll help shape the future of how we run the enterprise. You'll build the products and platform that map how Roblox works — who our people are, how our organization is structured, and what work is happening. With AI transforming the way we work, you'll help make this company data trusted and accessible to both employees and AI agents, helping Roblox operate at 10x efficiency.

You Will

• Work across engineering, product, finance, people, and talent teams to innovate how we run the company, defining and refining requirements for high-impact internal products.

• Drive alignment across teams, shaping product requirements and ensuring everyone is working toward the same vision.

• Lead projects from end to end, ensuring they are well-planned, high-quality, and impactful.

• Work across a wide range of technologies, from frontend and backend to data pipelines and infrastructure, learning quickly to solve complex challenges.

• Uphold high engineering standards, building scalable, performant, and future-proof systems.

• Explore and apply AI to improve efficiency, embracing new tools and approaches that drive a 10x impact.

You Have

• 1-3 years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality production code.

• Coding Proficiency: Strong programming skills in at least one modern language (e.g., TypeScript, Python)

• Problem-Solving Skills: A solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms, with an aptitude for debugging complex issues.

• Communication : Ability to work clearly and collaboratively with engineers and non-technical partners

• Education: A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent professional experience) in Computer Science or a related engineering field.

Please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future F-1 or H-1B sponsorship at this time.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page .

Annual Salary Range

$153,120 — $196,750 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

title: Security Engineer, Product Security
description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

What You'll Do

• Architecture & strategy

• Define security architecture for Flexport's products and services , and set the patterns and reference implementations that make secure-by-default the path of least resistance.

• Lead security engineering reviews for the highest-risk product features , and set the bar for what "good" looks like in reviews you don't personally run.

• Build and scale the security champions program and product security training that extend your judgment into teams where you can't be in every review.

• Design-time & review

• Lead domain-specific threat modeling and attack surface analysis across Flexport's product surface, not just individual features.

• Partner with engineering leadership to resolve the design tradeoffs that a senior engineer would escalate.

• Vulnerability management

• Set the bar for how the team triages, reproduces, and prioritizes bug bounty submissions and internal security reports, and step in on the hardest or highest-severity cases.

• Drive remediation of systemic classes of vulnerability , not just individual findings.

• Developer enablement & leadership

• Own the security services and tooling consumed by product teams across our global infrastructure.

• Mentor other engineers on the team, and act as the authoritative technical voice on product security across engineering leadership.

You Should Have

• Typically 2–5 years of experience in product/application security or software development with a security focus — we care more about what you've built than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply; we'd rather see your work than filter you out on a résumé line.

• Strong grasp of web application security principles and common attack vectors (e.g., OWASP Top 10)

• Proficiency with application testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or browser developer tools

• Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language (e.g., Ruby, Java/Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python) and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure)

• Comfortable with security on-call rotation and picking up work across security disciplines when needed

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience with bug bounty platforms

• Hands-on experience with SAST tools (Cycode, Semgrep, Snyk, or similar)

• Experience with cloud infrastructure security and container technologies

• Participation in CTF events or open-source security projects

• Familiarity with threat modeling frameworks and secure SDLC best practices

• Interest in contributing to internal developer security training programs

How We Work

• We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs

• We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one

• We're agile, but not dogmatic — the team decides how it works best

Why This Role Is Special

• Massive leverage: the conventions and champions program you build are multiplied across hundreds of engineers who never talk to you directly.

title: Summer 2027 Intern - Software Engineering
description:
Company Description

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

Job Description

This posting supports current and anticipated early-career hiring needs. Applying allows our recruiting team to consider you for opportunities that align with your qualifications, preferences, and availability. An immediate opening or interview is not guaranteed.

Where are these roles located? You’ll have the opportunity to work with teams in:

• Colorado Springs, Colorado
• Irvine, California
• Longmont, Colorado
• Fremont, California
• Rochester, Minnesota
• San Jose, California System Tools Software Intern :

Build the software behind the technology.

As a System Tools Software Intern , you'll create the software that powers engineering teams and next-generation products. You'll design, develop, test, and improve tools that make systems faster, more reliable, and easier to build.

In this role, you may:

• Design and develop system software, utilities, and engineering tools.
• Build or enhance operating systems, compilers, networking tools, databases, and Internet-based applications.
• Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize software performance.
• Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to ensure seamless integration.
• Help influence hardware design by developing software that works efficiently with new technologies. Applications Software Intern:

Create software that helps teams work smarter.

As an Applications Software Engineer , you'll develop applications that support employees, customers, and business operations. You'll design, build, test, and improve software used across enterprise systems.

In this role, you may:

• Design, develop, and maintain commercial and internal software applications.
• Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using modern programming languages.
• Test, debug, and improve application performance.
• Collaborate with teammates to build new features and solve technical problems.
• Create documentation that supports software deployment and ongoing maintenance. Data Analytics Intern :

Turn data into insights that drive better decisions.

As a Data Analytics Engineer , you'll build the tools and data systems that help teams understand performance, improve products, and solve business challenges. You'll work with large datasets to create meaningful insights that influence engineering and business decisions.

In this role, you may:

• Design and develop data pipelines, databases, and data warehouses.
• Build software and automation tools for collecting, processing, and analyzing data.
• Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that support decision-making.
• Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
• Analyze data to identify trends, improve processes, and solve complex problems. Firmware Engineering Intern :

Write the code that brings hardware to life.

As a Firmware Intern , you'll develop the low-level software that allows hardware devices to function. Working at the intersection of hardware and software, you'll help build reliable, high-performance embedded systems used in next-generation technology.

In this role, you may:

• Design, develop, test, and debug embedded firmware.
• Write software using C, C++, assembly, and other low-level programming languages.
• Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate software with electronic systems.
• Troubleshoot firmware and hardware interactions to improve performance and reliability.
• Support new product development from concept through production. This role is part of WD's early career development program. WD's early career development program is ideal for individuals at the early stages of their professional career. Participants receive foundational training through structured onboarding, mentorship, and a curated development curriculum. The responsibilities of this role are typically aligned with candidates who have approximately 0–2+ years of relevant professional experience, though candidates of all experience levels are encouraged to apply.

Systems Design & Integration Intern:

Bring complex systems together.

As a Systems Design & Integration Engineer , you'll help ensure hardware and software work together seamlessly. You'll collaborate across engineering teams to design, integrate, test, and optimize complete system solutions for next-generation products.

In this role, you may:

• Define system requirements and technical specifications.
• Evaluate hardware and software compatibility.
• Coordinate the integration of multiple subsystems into complete products.
• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system-level issues.
• Recommend improvements that enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability.
Qualifications

Required:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Experience developing technical skills through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects using one or more programming languages such as C, C++, Python, Java, Go (Golang), SQL, JavaScript, or similar technologies .
• Familiarity with software development fundamentals, debugging, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, or other computer engineering concepts.
• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with a passion for learning new technologies.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common software development tools (such as Git, Linux, or IDEs) is a plus.
• Interest in storage technologies, semiconductors, embedded systems, cloud computing, AI, data analytics, or other emerging technologies.
Additional Information

WD is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants and employees and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on their race, color, ancestry, religion (including religious dress and grooming standards), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), gender (including a person’s gender identity, gender expression, and gender-related appearance and behavior, whether or not stereotypically associated with the person’s assigned sex at birth), age, national origin, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status (including domestic partnership status), physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, protected medical and family care leave, Civil Air Patrol status, military and veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We also prohibit harassment of any individual on any of the characteristics listed above. Our non-discrimination policy applies to all aspects of employment. We comply with the laws and regulations set forth in the " Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal ” poster. Our pay transparency policy is available here .

WD thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.

WD is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@wdc.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

Based on our experience, we anticipate that the application deadline will be 1/20/27, although we reserve the right to close the application process sooner if we hire an applicant for this position before the application deadline. If we are not able to hire someone from this role before the application deadline, we will update this posting with a new anticipated application deadlin
